summary: Frontend-only retest of the iteration_7 fixes, done with Playwright at 400x860 on the preview URL. ALL PASS. (1) Act intro: tested 11 fresh runs and 4 seeds x acts 2-5 (localStorage jumps to W11/21/31/41). The crests never contain (imgs=0) and render immediately as shield placeholders. Initials come from the team name only: Occult=O, Royal Academy=RA, Zeus=Z, The Empire=E, Epsilon Kai=EK, Selezione Alius=SA, Selezione Alius · Ghiaccio=AG, Knights of Queen=KQ, Little Gigant=LG. Captions read 'Miniboss · X' / 'Boss · Y'. X was never equal to Y, and act-intro-why mentioned both X and Y in every case. Contrast: Zeus is #854d0e on #f8fafc and The Empire is #0c4a6e on #7dd3fc, both readable dark text. Act 1 matchups vary across random seeds (RA/Occult, Occult/RA, Zeus/Occult, RA/Zeus, Occult/Zeus). (2) Talenti tab opens without crashing. With 20 PT, Colpo di Testa and the Maestria node are locked at first; buying Tiro di Base takes the balance to 19 and unlocks Colpo di Testa. All 3 tabs are present. (3) The act 1 consequence with the Occult boss (pending injected at W11) reads: 'La vittoria su Occult fa il giro di Tokyo... Jude Sharp, che vi osservava dalla tribuna, lascia la Royal e sceglie la Raimon.' It reads coherently. (4) Abandoning at W1: the end screen has no journey-log and no empty panel. The uncompleted challenges are rgb(148,163,184) (slate-400) and readable. No page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: TeamCrest: CREST_FILES is an empty Set, so the path is dead code until crests are added. That is fine, but the useState initialiser will not react if the teamId prop changes on the same instance (minor).
Notes from iteration_7 that are still open (not retested): runTalentPoints uses floor(reached/10), and the W10 threshold for 'Nessuna fuga' is ambiguous.
seed_data_creation: None. Only browser localStorage was used, in disposable Playwright contexts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To inject the consequence screen: create a run, set run.pending={type:'consequence',actId:'act1',bossId:'occult',context:{}}, wave=11, completedWave=10, introSeen=1, then reload -> continue-run-btn -> next-wave-btn. The act intro crest initials are in the first inner div of act-intro-crest-N, and the caption is in its span.
